## The ruling

**A — one last 17.x release from `main` before the v18 line opens, through the existing lane** (refresh the version PR, CI, the maintainer merges it and approves the release). **Its list is fixes only:**
- #21908's engine-level deny (p1 security; ruled in batch #281, final build pending the two producer rows held with the maintainer);
- #21980 / #22004 (p2 security, batch #282 item 1);
- any framework-side fix cloud's open p1s name (for example cloud#2637, if its bisect names a framework commit);
- the 5 fixes already on `main` ride along.
- ⛔ **#21898 (`feat(spec)!`, PR #21974) is not on the list**: a narrowing breaking change does not go into the closing release of a line whose users may never upgrade; it lands after the opening, in 18.0.

No deadline was set by the maintainer. A′ (publish now without waiting for #21908) is the fallback if the maintainer sets one and #21908 misses it. B was not taken.
